title: Proposed: drop the expansion-without-squeeze trigger
detail: Shorts need a real squeeze release, like longs. Asymmetry moves to exits only (2.5R target vs trailing).
oosImpact: No OOS look. Gamma shorts fell from 268 to 75 (MNQ) and 186 to 67 (MES); MNQ PF 1.02 to 1.18, MES PF 0.81 to 0.78. Trades fell below the 150 gate.
